items.decision_note: The supplied evidence does not safely establish whether the short presentation became an independently accepted deliverable or remained an implementation approach for model clarity.

items.reason: Requirement boundaries still changed in the final configured audit round.

unresolved_candidate.description: A separate short presentation file may have become an independent deliverable, but the client primarily requested a simpler and clearer model and did not clearly accept a standalone presentation specification.

The proposed Case C, tapered availability payment, corridor levy, refinancing, and anchor-tenant scenarios were freelancer suggestions explicitly described as not yet in the model; no client acceptance establishes them as Requirements.
